messages:
Maya: thanks for joining the all-hands today! dropping a short follow-up thread for action items and a few clarifications we promised during Q&A.

Rio: slides & recording: https://internal.redwood.ai/ah/mar-2026 (slides+video)

Ana: need precise Dedicated SLA start date for contract teams. the slide said H2.

Maya: Dedicated SLA effective 2026-08-01 for new reserved contracts. existing Dedicated customers can opt-in at renewal or earlier with a written request.

CJ: Private (VPC) GA status? we heard late Q3.

Maya: target Private GA 2026-09-15; blockers: KMS integration and audit-log retention policy.

Sam: finance question: will burst pricing be a separate invoice line?

Rio: yes, Burst Capacity billed separately as a usage line item. committed spend covers baseline reserved GPUs. finance will get the billing schema doc.

Ana: who owns publishing the billing schema? need a single owner for legal.

CJ: @Sam please own billing schema doc and coordinate with Finance & Legal. confirm by EOD?

Sam: will do. looping in Leah (Finance) and Priya (Legal) now.

Maya: tech clarification on model rollout fallbacks: automatic fallback to quantized-compatible variant in-region, then cross-region if policy permits.

Rio: referenced rollout policy snippet:

```
policy:
  prefer: replica-optimized
  fallback: quantized-compatible
  cross_region_failover: conditional
  max_latency_ms: 200
```

Maya: Ops: early-access for Private available via NDA. teams should DM me with expected capacity.

CJ: action items from Q&A:
- Sam: publish billing schema + legal pack (owner)
- Rio: upload annotated slides + recording (done)
- Maya: draft early-access process for Private (owner)
- Ana: confirm Dedicated SLA language for contracts (owner)

Leah: flag for Finance 5: will review billing schema once Sam posts.

DeployBot: recording processed for 1782001120. transcript: https://internal.redwood.ai/transcripts/1782001120.txt

Maya: I'll update the roadmap doc with the explicit dates and link back here. any more follow-ups drop them in thread or DM me. :rocket:

Ana: thanks! I'll remove ambiguity from the contract snippet and post to contracts repo.

Sam: posted draft billing schema here: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/billing-schema-draft-2026-03-23. feedback welcome.

Maya: closing the loop - great questions and great turnout.
